title: 第303章 给你们的教训
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

伸手不打笑脸人。

鞋耙子脸默不作声地拿着肉片离开，想了想，一口塞进嘴里吞掉了。

天气这么热，他可不想重新生火，热得要死。

葛壮一脸温柔地看着田曼琪。

他就知道，田曼琪是个小天使，她甚至会用自己的善良感化一个恶人。

太阳终于要升起，田曼琪带着众人往回走。

等走到后山，山洞里的人基本也就歇下了，她们可以顺势回农村小院。

刚进屋，太阳刚好升起来，外面的温度逐渐升腾。

“太饿了，再吃点吧，这样根本没法睡觉。”

一天只吃了一小片肉，谁能受得了？

田曼琪也饿。

她挥了挥手，叫过来葛壮。

“拿出来12块肉，切大点给大家吃。”

12块肉，每人只能分到三小片，基本就是个两分饱。

拿到了肉的人，囫囵吞下，胃里仍然是饿的。

他们看着袋子里的食物，要想每个人都吃饱，估计一顿就能把所有的肉都吃完。

田曼琪眼珠一转：“你们想吃饱？”

“想啊，饿的抓心挠肝的。”

“田管理，你是不是还有什么办法？”

“跟我出来。”

田曼琪站起身，走进院子里。

院子墙不高，能看清远处的风景。

她指了指下洼村的仓库。

田曼琪小声道：“那有物资，大量的物资，只要咱们进去，就能吃饱！”

所有人都一脸不可思议。

“不可能的，下洼村驻守那么严，咱们怎么可能吃得上？”

田曼琪：“不入虎穴，焉得虎子。不冒险怎么能拿到吃的？白天是睡觉时间，也是防备最薄弱的时候，得手的概率很大。

而且周凛不敢杀咱们，被抓住了跑就是了。”

葛壮秒跟：“有道理，想吃东西就得冒险，我跟你去！”

田曼琪的目光扫向众人：“谁去，谁就能分到更多的食物。”

“我也去吧。”

“那我也去。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Don’t reach out to hit the smiling person.

Shoe Rake Face silently took the piece of meat and left. After thinking about it, he stuffed it into his mouth and swallowed it.

He didn't want to start a new fire when it was so hot, it was so hot.

Ge Zhuang looked at Tian Manqi tenderly.

He knew that Tian Manqi was a little angel, and she would even use her kindness to influence a bad person.

The sun was finally rising, and Tian Manqi led everyone back.

By the time they reached the back mountain, the people in the cave had basically rested, and they could go back to the rural courtyard.

As soon as I entered the house, the sun was just rising, and the temperature outside was gradually rising.

"I'm so hungry. Let's eat some more. I won't be able to sleep like this."

Who can bear to eat only a small piece of meat a day?

Tian Manqi is also hungry.

She waved her hand and called Ge Zhuang over.

"Take out 12 pieces of meat and cut it into larger pieces for everyone to eat."

There are 12 pieces of meat, and each person can only get three small slices, which is basically enough for two cents.

The person who got the meat swallowed it whole, but his stomach was still hungry.

They looked at the food in the bag. If they wanted everyone to be full, they would probably eat all the meat in one meal.

Tian Manqi rolled her eyes: "Do you want to eat enough?"

"Think about it, I'm so hungry that I'm scratching my head."

"Manager Tian, is there anything else you can do?"

"Come out with me."

Tian Manqi stood up and walked into the yard.

The courtyard wall is not high, so you can see the distant scenery clearly.

She pointed to the warehouse in Xiawa Village.

Tian Manqi whispered: "There are supplies there, a lot of supplies. As long as we go in, we can eat enough!"

Everyone looked incredulous.

"Impossible, Xiawa Village is so heavily guarded, how can we possibly get food?"

Tian Manqi: "If you don't enter the tiger's den, you won't catch the tiger's cubs. How can you get food without taking risks? During the day, you are sleeping time and when your defenses are weakest, the probability of success is very high.

And Zhou Lin doesn't dare to kill us, he will just run away if he is caught."

Ge Zhuang immediately followed: "That makes sense. If you want to eat, you have to take risks. I'll go with you!"

Tian Manqi glanced at everyone: "Whoever goes will get more food."

"I'll go too."

"Then I'll go too."
